ItemDef.Name: pedigree_uncompressed
ItemDef.redcap:FieldNote: NEVER_COMPRESS on this field's tag overrides the project's Compress Data, so the stored GA4GH JSON is readable here. Uncompressed, this pedigree is over the field's size limit, so it's stored without its diagram image and the form shows a placeholder.

ItemDef.Name: pedigree_old_tag
ItemDef.redcap:FieldNote: 1.0.0 no longer recognises @PEDIGREE_HPO, so this is a plain notes field. Replace the tag with @PEDIGREE and set Default Terminology to HPO + omim.
